title: ScatterChart
description: Dots positioned by two values, with per-point size, color and label. Zooms on both axes.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Two series of [x, y] tuples with axis titles; the tooltip shows the nearest dot.

labels.title: Labels and sizes
labels.description: Point objects carry a label and a size; showLabels draws the labels, skipping overlaps.

large-data.title: 200,000 points
